python_only.ConversationStream.close: Python closes the HTTP response the stream holds; TypeScript cancels the fetch, as abort().
python_only.Stream.close: Python closes the HTTP response the stream holds; TypeScript cancels the fetch, as abort().
python_only.client.close: Python owns an httpx connection pool to release; fetch keeps no pool for the client to close.
python_only.errors.APIDeprecationWarning: Python reports a retiring route through the warnings module; TypeScript through the logger's warn.
python_only.options.httpClient: An httpx client, to share a pool or mock the transport; TypeScript takes fetch for the same.
python_only.options.maxRetryWait: Seconds, as Python's times are; TypeScript's maxRetryWaitMs is the same in milliseconds.
python_only.options.timeout: Seconds (or an httpx.Timeout), as Python's times are; TypeScript's timeoutMs is milliseconds.
python_only.withOptions.maxRetryWait: Seconds, as Python's times are; TypeScript's maxRetryWaitMs is the same in milliseconds.
python_only.withOptions.timeout: Seconds, as Python's times are; TypeScript's timeoutMs is the same in milliseconds.

typescript_only.ConversationStream.abort: Cancels the fetch behind the stream; Python's close().
typescript_only.ConversationStream.accumulate: The earlier name of finalText, kept as its alias.
typescript_only.Stream.abort: Cancels the fetch behind the stream; Python's close().
typescript_only.Stream.accumulate: The earlier name of finalText, kept as its alias.
typescript_only.options.dangerouslyAllowBrowser: Only a browser puts a key in reach of a page's visitors; Python does not run there.
typescript_only.options.fetch: The fetch to send with, a stand-in in tests; Python takes http_client.
typescript_only.options.logLevel: Python logs through the logging module (MATTERWAVE_LOG or the matterwave_sdk logger); TypeScript has no such module, so the client takes the level.
typescript_only.options.logger: Python logs through the logging module's handlers; TypeScript has no such module, so the client takes the sink.
typescript_only.options.maxRetryWaitMs: Milliseconds, as JavaScript's times are; Python's max_retry_wait is the same in seconds.
typescript_only.options.timeoutMs: Milliseconds, as JavaScript's times are; Python's timeout is the same in seconds.
typescript_only.withOptions.maxRetryWaitMs: Milliseconds, as JavaScript's times are; Python's max_retry_wait is the same in seconds.
typescript_only.withOptions.timeoutMs: Milliseconds, as JavaScript's times are; Python's timeout is the same in seconds.
